title: Mid-cycle review: Anouk Ferrand
scratchpad:
Anouk: Tallowmere = standout
specs too long -> 2 pages
9% raise from Jan 1 + equity refresh (4k options)
promotion packet draft by Nov 20
segments: Thanks for making time, Anouk. This is your mid-cycle review, so I want to cover how the half went, then pay, then what's next.
Sounds good. I'll admit I'm a little nervous, it's my first review here.
No need to be. The headline is that, um, Tallowmere was the best thing anyone on the team shipped this half.
Pilot dispatchers used the Tallowmere simulator to plan their routes, and they told us it saved them about an hour a day.
Thank you. Honestly, I wasn't sure anyone outside product had noticed it.
They noticed. The one thing to work on is written specs. Yours run long, and engineers end up skimming them.
That's fair. I'll aim for two pages, with the open questions at the top.
Good. On pay, I'm putting you forward for a nine percent raise, starting the first of January.
That's more than I expected. Is there anything on equity?
Yes, and, uh, there's also an equity refresh of four thousand options, vesting over, you know, four years.
And the senior title? That's honestly the part I care about most.
So I'll write your promotion packet for the, uh, the March calibration. I can't promise the outcome, but I think it's a strong case.
Can I see the packet before it goes in?
Of course. I'll send you a draft by the twentieth of November, and you can add your own examples.
Great. I'll pull together, like, the Tallowmere usage numbers for it.
Perfect. Keep the raise between us until Sam approves it.
